title: feat(site): home, apps, community and header polish
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The home page adds a requests-in-the-last-hour stat, makes model counts more prominent, and limits weekly and newest app listings to English-language apps. The Community page corrects its numbers, adds GitHub contributors and displays 26 supporter logos. The header and footer now use the shared UI package, and a new 404 page features Polli. App cards get loading states at their actual size and one link per app; references to pollen use lower-case spelling. The unused build diary was removed. Play styles remain with #16213 to avoid breaking the current Play audio class.

image.prompt: A cozy pixel art garden website shows a glowing requests counter, app cards, contributor portraits and a wall of tiny supporter badges, with lime green (#ecf874) prominently across the scene and soft pastel gradients behind the sprites. Polli wears a tiny webmaster scarf and points at an app card: she is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized or realistic, in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines and a warm cream backdrop.
